contextgroups.description: Event Context containers. Each Group holds Contexts that are related in some application-defined way, such as all Contexts of a site, a production line or a tenant

contexts.description: Role-keyed references to the entities that give events their context, such as a Message definition, a payload schema, the emitting entity and a target model. A Context has no document

references.name: references
references.description: References keyed by Role. A Role states what the referenced representation means for an event that names this Context

url.name: url
url.description: Absolute URL of the referenced representation. Consumers use it as given
